# RenderTarget

Namespace `Nfty.Model.Render` in assembly `Nfty.Model`.

```csharp
public sealed class RenderTarget
```

A plain pixel-and-depth surface `Raster` writes into: one background-filled color per pixel and a z-buffer initialized to "nothing here yet". The array references are fixed at construction (D7); their contents mutate freely as `Raster` draws. Single owner; not thread-safe.

## Constructors

### RenderTarget(int, int) { #m-ctor-system-int32-system-int32 }

```csharp
public RenderTarget(int width, int height);
```

Allocates a [`RenderTarget.Width`](Nfty.Model.Render.RenderTarget.md#p-width) × [`RenderTarget.Height`](Nfty.Model.Render.RenderTarget.md#p-height) surface. Both dimensions must be positive.

**Parameters**

- `width` (`int`) - Width in pixels; must be positive.
- `height` (`int`) - Height in pixels; must be positive.

**Exceptions**

- `ArgumentOutOfRangeException` - A dimension is not positive.

### Depth { #p-depth }

```csharp
public float[] Depth { get; }
```

One depth value per pixel, same shape as [`RenderTarget.Color`](Nfty.Model.Render.RenderTarget.md#p-color). Smaller is closer; `PositiveInfinity` means nothing has drawn there yet.
